Provision of source address The DM shall provide the source address (SA) of the diagnostic client from which the diagnostic request was received within metaInfo using the Key kSA in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.

Provision of target address The DM shall provide the target address (TA) of the diagnostic server to which the diagnostic request was sent within metaInfo using the Key kTA in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.

Provision of UDS addressing mode The DM shall provide the UDS addressing mode (TAType) of the diagnostic request (physical or functional) within metaInfo using the Key kTAType in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
Provision of request handle The DM shall provide the request handle of the diagnostic request within metaInfo using the Key kRequestHandle in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
Provision of local IP address The DM shall provide the local IP address within metaInfo using the Key kLocalIP in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
Provision of local port number The DM shall provide the local port number within metaInfo using the Key kLocalPort in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.

Provision of DTC number The DM shall provide the DTC number for which the interfaces is triggered within metaInfo using the Key kDtc in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces for the purpose of extended data and snapshot data collection.

Valid values for the attribute maxTesterConnections of meta-class DoIpNetworkConfiguration Values of DoIpNetworkConfiguration.maxTesterConnections shall be from ’1’ to ’255’.

Default value for the attribute priority of meta-class GenericTpConnection If the attribute DoIpNetworkConfigurationDesign.tpConnection.priority is not configured, the Diagnostic Server instance shall use a value of 255.

DoIP protocol semantics based on the configured DoIP protocol version The DM shall adapt the DoIP protocol behavior based on the configured DoIpFunctionalClusterDesign.doIpProtocolVersion value and shall use only DoIP messages (values, payload types, ...) that are specified by the selected ISO 13400-2[2] protocol version.
